text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day before the "Joint 
Mini-Live"...! When I arrived at the venue 
to help out, the four performing horse 
girls were there.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haa-hahaha! So you are our support staff! 
Fufufu, did you volunteer just to catch a 
glimpse of my glorious self backstage?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Of course not.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-Nice to meet yooou~! I-I'll do my 
besht so I don't drag everyone dooown... 
best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan, just relax. Let's make this the 
best live performance together tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rehearsal begins. Narita Top Road showed 
off the solid results of her diligent 
practice so far. However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! My hand bumped into the 
stage set...!

text_block_list.name: Stage Director
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the stage is narrower than we 
anticipated. Apologies, let's adjust the 
choreography. With tighter, smaller 
movements—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Tighter, smaller movements... Ah!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMACK...!!)

text_block_list.name: Stage Director
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, let's have Top Road-san 
skip the dancing for this part... and have 
her sing it as a solo instead...!

text_block_list.name: Stage Director
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for the sudden change... But 
we'll adjust the staging so you can give 
it your maximum performance...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm the one who should apologize. 
It's because I couldn't adapt...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going back to rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems Ayabe-san has faith. 
"There is still time, surely she will 
prevail!" she says!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand completely...! After all, 
she's Top Road-san...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Oh, Narita Top Road! Our esteemed 
rival! The Overlord guarantees your 
prowess! She shall emerge from her cocoon 
by daybreak...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Director...! Could you give me until 
tomorrow? I will master it without fail!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —One! Two! —One, two, three!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... One more time! As many times 
as it takes until I get it...!
choice_data_list: No, let's take it easy and not rush.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have to learn the dance from 
scratch. She already has all the effort 
she's built up so far.
choice_data_list:
You can definitely build upon your past 
efforts...!

You can definitely build upon your past 
efforts...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...! My past... efforts...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Right... I'm not starting from zero. I 
have everything I've accumulated so 
far...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(My wish to "live up to everyone's 
expectations"... Everything I've built up 
with that feeling in mind...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—You're absolutely right. All my effort up 
to now won't go to waste. No, I won't let 
it go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
First is "assessing the situation"... Next 
is "analyzing the issues"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's calmly identify my weak spots. I'll 
study the video they recorded during 
rehearsal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —And, hop! Haa, haa... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With this performance, I'm sure the 
director will approve...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...At this rate, I feel like... I can do 
something even more incredible!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! Why not just go all out and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day, right before showtime. The 
moment to show the fruits of her practice 
has arrived...!

text_block_list.name: Stage Director
text_block_list.text:
...Wha! Top Road-san... You're really 
going to do "both"...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll prove I can do it...! 
...*Inhales*—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Run right through this moment~♪ It's not 
over yet! I want to reach it~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing... Both the dance and the solo 
are flawless...! Her singing voice is so 
steady too~!!

text_block_list.name: Stage Director
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent... I'm blown away...! Let's 
definitely keep both your dance and solo 
for this part! This is going to blow the 
crowd away...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...!! Yes!! I'll give it my all to get 
everyone cheering...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Despair steals away hope"... yet you have 
"emerged from the dark forest, surpassing 
our expectations"! Ah, truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, thank you so much. Thanks to 
you, I was able to believe in myself and 
do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Fufu! Are you mimicking what I 
said during the makeup exam?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm heading out. Please watch 
our triumphant performance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words and a radiant smile, 
Narita Top Road dashed toward the stage.
